test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: India's nominal gross domestic product (GDP) at current prices was estimated to be at Rs. 232.15 trillion (USS 3.12 trillion) in FY22. With more than 100 unicoms valued at USS 332.7 billion, India had the _______ unicom base in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **third - largest**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **India had the third-largest unicorn base in the world:**

 
 
• India's nominal GDP at current prices was estimated to be Rs. 232.15 trillion (USD 3.12 trillion) in FY22.
 
• The country boasts more than 100 unicorns valued at USD 332.7 billion, placing it third globally in terms of the number of unicorns.
 
• Unicorns are privately held startup companies valued at over USD 1 billion, and having a significant number indicates a robust entrepreneurial ecosystem and innovation landscape.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Second-largest unicorn base:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. The second-largest unicorn base is held by China, with the United States leading globally.
 
• India, despite its impressive number of unicorns, does not surpass China in this regard.
 
 
 
• **Sixth-largest unicorn base:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. India ranks higher than sixth in the global unicorn rankings.
 
• Countries with fewer unicorns than India include Germany, the United Kingdom, and South Korea.
 
 
 
• **Eight-largest unicorn base:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. India ranks much higher in terms of the number of unicorns compared to the eighth position.
 
• Countries with significantly fewer unicorns include Japan, France, and Canada.
